questions.stem: Which of the following is true regarding spinal, epidural, and local anesthesia?

options.label: A
options.text: Epidural anesthesia is performed by injecting anesthetic into the intrathecal space.

options.label: B
options.text: Local anesthetics work by blocking calcium channels, preventing nerve impulse propagation.

options.label: C
options.text: Spinal anesthesia is commonly used for procedures above the umbilicus.

options.label: D
options.text: The absolute contraindication for local anesthesia is an allergy to the anesthetic.
